name: 世纪
english_description: A member of the "Warring States" codebase family (an adm/obj/master.lpc branch) — despite a slug resembling sje/sjecl (the "Book and Sword" series) elsewhere in this archive, it's an entirely unrelated lineage from those Century/adm-single titles. Its setting is science-fiction interstellar war rather than traditional wuxia: new characters start in the Tianlang star sector, buy starships at the spaceport, and align with one of four rival factions, with even wizard rank displayed under the in-universe title "Galaxy Special Police."
